messages:
ashley: Heads up — we're proposing adding an `X-Route-Priority` header to the public API so the smart router can prefer lower-cost capacity pools. This will be emitted by Console rollouts and picked up by runtime. It changes the SDK request contract (TS/Go) if we make it required. Thoughts on a safe rollout? :thinking:

liam: +1 on the header, but runtime should accept the old and new names for compatibility. Suggest accepting `x-route-priority` and `x-rd-route-priority` for a transition period, and fall back to body metadata when absent. Also we should emit a telemetry event when the header is used.

morgan: From SDK POV: Type-level changes in TS will break consumer builds if we force a required field. Proposal: keep the header optional in SDKs, add a one-time-per-session console warning in dev builds, and ship a minor bump. We'll add a migration note in changelogs.

sandra: Console questions: if we expose per-route priority in the UI, do we want users to be able to set quotas based on priority buckets? That will affect billing dashboards and quota dashboards. We should prototype a tile showing "Priority impact" (latency/cost delta) in canary.

ashley: Draft rollout plan: 1) Runtime shim accepts both header names for 90 days then logs a deprecation warning. 2) SDKs (TS/Go): accept header optional, log warning in dev mode, release minor versions. Python already passthroughs headers so low effort. 3) Console: add toggle + canary tile for 2 weeks. 4) Telemetry: add `route_priority` flag to traces + route-level metric. Need a PR/checklist for each.

liam: PR checklist (starter): - OpenAPI update + examples - Runtime header fallback + integration test - SDKs: update types, add dev warning tests - Telemetry schema bump (trace field) - Quota-sim runs for priority buckets - Docs: migration + changelog

morgan: Example SDK snippet for TS to include in the migration doc:
```ts
// optional header, prefer SDK helper
client.request({
  path: '/v1/generate',
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'x-route-priority': 'low' // optional, runtime will fall back
  },
  body: { prompt: '...' }
})
```
Include guidance: do not rely on header for auth-sensitive routing; use pinned models for strict isolation.

devex-bot: Created ticket RED-1234 for Console work + RED-1235 for SDK changes. Linked to RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/route-priority. :white_check_mark:

ashley: Thanks. I'll schedule a small canary rollout next Tue. @morgan can you draft the TS/Go changelog blurbs? @liam please add the runtime shim PR and integration tests. We'll reconvene after PRs are up. :eyes:
